subject.declared_domain: The C0 rung of the C0..C4 system ladder: FACTS -- the role-typed objects of the Opal estate graph, spanning the BACKEND (AWS), FRONTEND (portal source) and KNOWLEDGE (Microsoft 365) substrate sides. The canon declares it as 'FACTS ~20k NODES: role-typed objects (14 roles)' and marks it VIEW-COMPILED (live derivation, never hand-declared).

methodology.how: C0 is view-compiled, not authored. The globgrph derive runner scans the live AWS estate and the repo source tree and materializes each discovered object as a row in the Iceberg table graph_nodes, carrying node_id, node_type and a JSON props blob. A separate build projects that table into the local kuzu_nessie_db for traversal. The ROLE vocabulary (14 roles) lives in the rule bank and is COMPOSED onto the node population by the node_bindings map; it is not a field the producer writes. The producer therefore ORIGINATES the node_type vocabulary (58 distinct types live) while the rule bank DECLARES the 14-role vocabulary, and node_bindings is the only thing joining them.
composes: live AWS estate (CloudTrail management events + service describe scans)
invents: the node_type vocabulary itself -- 58 distinct values live, of which 10 are named nowhere in the rule bank
node_id construction for non-ARN objects (repo-relative paths, S3 key glob patterns, synthetic motif:/motifi: ids)
methodology.evidence: Producer read at infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py:1357-1362 and :1645-1699 @ec0408628a (working tree clean at that commit). Live node_type census: comp-kuzu 'MATCH (n) RETURN n.node_type AS t, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC' -> 58 distinct node_types over 27,035 nodes at snapshot 2902399899597701830. Role vocabulary read at org/modules/graph/NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#roles @5fc45ad69d -> exactly 14: Source, Store, Producer, Transformer, Consumer, Sink, Gateway, Guard, Router, Trigger, Registry, Container, Observer, Custodian. DETERMINISM IS 'unknown' AND WAS NOT EXERCISED: I did not fire a second full derive to compare outputs. A re-run would not be a clean control in any case, because the estate mutates between runs and the CloudTrail incremental writes continuously -- so a diff would conflate producer non-determinism with genuine estate change. Naming the instrument that WOULD settle it: two derives against a pinned input snapshot, which is not a read this lane can perform.

coverage.universe: Every role-typed object the derive runner discovers across the three declared substrate sides: BACKEND (AWS resources), FRONTEND (portal React/TS source objects), KNOWLEDGE (Microsoft 365 files, folders, users).
coverage.denominator: 27,035 of 27,035 nodes carry a non-null node_type (58 distinct types) -- zero untyped. Of those, 20,750 of 27,035 nodes (76.8%) sit under a node_type that node_bindings maps to a role bucket; 6,285 of 27,035 (23.2%) do not. By type rather than volume: 48 of 58 live node_types are named in node_bindings, 10 of 58 are not.
explicitly_out: TypeDecl, Type, Symbol, Concept -- declared scope_out in NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#node_bindings, i.e. deliberately outside the role vocabulary rather than missed

the 10 live node_types absent from node_bindings entirely: C2Motif, C3System, CODEBUILD_PROJECT, EC2_INSTANCE, ECS_CLUSTER, ECS_TASK_DEFINITION, IAM_USER, LOAD_BALANCER, ROUTE53_RECORD, VPC_ENDPOINT -- these are NOT declared out, they are simply unbound, which is a different thing and is the finding
4 of the 14 declared roles carry NO node_binding at all: Custodian, Producer, Router, Source -- so those roles cannot be populated from node_type by the declared map
coverage.evidence: Full census computed from the materialized comp-kuzu result set, not from a page: 'MATCH (n) RETURN n.node_type AS t, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC' joined in python against NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#node_bindings @5fc45ad69d. Untyped control: 'MATCH (n) WHERE n.node_type IS NULL RETURN count(n)' -> 0, against 'MATCH (n) RETURN count(n)' -> 27,035, so the 58-type census spans the whole population rather than a typed subset. NOTE ON PLANE: all figures are the kuzu PROJECTION plane at snapshot 2902399899597701830. 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X measured the Iceberg WAREHOUSE at 27,061 nodes; that is a different plane at a different vintage and the two are not in conflict. key.identity_space: node_id -- a HETEROGENEOUS space with no single grammar: AWS ARNs for cloud resources, repo-relative paths for source objects, S3 key glob patterns for object-store keys, and synthetic prefixed ids (motif:, motifi:) for ladder objects materialized into the same table.
key.declared_mapping: org/modules/graph/NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#node_bindings @5fc45ad69d -- EXISTS but is PARTIAL on both sides: 10 of 14 roles bound, 48 of 58 live node_types mapped, 20,750 of 27,035 nodes (76.8%) covered.
key.evidence: A DECLARED MAPPING DOES EXIST AND THIS CARD ALMOST CLAIMED OTHERWISE. A first pass compared the 58 live node_types against the 14 role NAMES directly and found 0 of 58 matching, which reads as a total absence of mapping. That comparison was against the wrong object: node_bindings is a role -> [node_type] map read at NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml#node_bindings @5fc45ad69d (12 buckets: 10 roles plus 'contextual' and 'scope_out'), and re-running the join against it gives 48 of 58 mapped. The 0-of-58 figure was true and about the wrong question. key_is_stable IS 'unknown' AND WAS NOT EXERCISED: the space demonstrably MIXES stable and mutable members -- ARNs survive ordinary change, while repo-relative paths and S3 key globs such as 'opal-data-bd/gold/_parity/account_gains/*/scorecard.json' (read from a live C2Motif instance props blob) do not survive a rename or restructure -- but this lane did not exercise a rename and watch an identity die, so the composition of the space is measured and the survival property is not.
key.owner: 4.0.0_SA_CRO / rule-bank ratification chain (the mapping's completeness); 0.4.0_DE_ClientPlatform (node_id construction)

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: TWO DIFFERENT BEHAVIOURS ON TWO DIFFERENT PLANES, and only one is loud. A PROPERTY-plane error is LOUD: querying a misspelled property raises 'ERROR: query failed: Binder exception: Cannot find property nodetype for n' and returns no count at all. A VALUE-plane miss is SILENT: querying a node_type that does not exist returns a clean, instant, well-formed 0 -- byte-identical to a genuine negative.
silent_degrade_paths: a stale kuzu projection answers every query cleanly at its own frozen vintage; the provenance header discloses the build time but the query result itself carries no vintage
a scratch database passed via --db-path is a frozen vintage that answers with full confidence
a node_type that was renamed upstream returns 0 under its old name with no signal that the name moved -- indistinguishable from the object genuinely not existing
the 6,285 nodes (23.2%) whose node_type is unbound in node_bindings are invisible to any role-keyed traversal, which returns a clean smaller answer rather than an error
failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED, FOUR ARMS, with the discriminating control run as a separate invocation. ARM 1 genuine negative -- real node_type LAMBDA with a node_id that does not exist -> 0. ARM 2 nonexistent node_type ZZZ_NO_SUCH_NODE_TYPE_9999 -> 0. ARM 3 nonexistent edge_type ZZZ_NO_SUCH_EDGE_9999 -> 0. ARM 4 misspelled PROPERTY n.nodetype -> Binder exception, loud. Arms 1 and 2 are byte-identical, which is the finding: the substrate cannot tell 'this does not exist' from 'you asked about a category I do not carry'. Arm 4 establishes that the instrument is live and CAN fail loudly, so the three zeros are real answers rather than a dead probe.
failure_mode.owner: 0.4.0_DE_ClientPlatform (producer); UNOWNED for the value-plane indistinguishability itself -- no seat currently owns making a C0 category-miss loud, and this card does not assign one

verdict.why: Every one of the seven rows is worked and carries basis, evidence and owner; no row is blank or guessed, so this is not INCOMPLETE. The subject is usable as load-bearing substrate WITHIN stated limits, which is why this is QUALIFIED rather than SOUND. Three measured defects bound that use: (1) the role mapping is PARTIAL in both directions -- 4 of 14 roles unbound and 6,285 of 27,035 nodes (23.2%) outside it -- so any role-keyed claim about C0 spans at most 76.8% of the population and must print that denominator; (2) a value-plane miss is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a genuine negative, exercised over four arms, so a clean zero from C0 is not evidence of absence; (3) determinism is unexercised and key stability is unexercised, both honestly marked unknown rather than assumed. None of the three blocks use outright -- each is a limit a consumer can respect if it is told, which is what this card does. NOT CLAIMED: that the 76.8% mapped subset is itself correct; this card measured mapping COVERAGE, never mapping CORRECTNESS.
